description: Zero Trust identity provider secrets: mark every IdentityProvider config's `client_secret` (documented 'Your OAuth Client Secret' / 'The client secret from the Duo Generic OIDC Relying Party metadata') and every SCIM config's `secret` (documented 'A read-only token generated when the SCIM integration is enabled for the first time') sensitive, on requests and responses, so they type as string | Redacted and decode as Redacted.
